data.text:
🔴 FILO JARS! 🔴 We’re bringing a '1' of a kind EP listening experience and merch pop-up to fans in Manila next week on July 9 at the Venice Grand Canal Mall @mckinleyhill_ from 10:00AM to 7:00PM!

Celebrate the release of @eajpark’s EP ‘1’ by participating in a stamp rally with specially curated booths where you can collect stamps and claim different tiers of prizes 🎁

Purchase any eaJ merch item during the event to begin your stamp-collecting journey—complete all 4 selected activities to get a chance to win a photo booth session with a familiar someone... 👀📸

Be sure to claim your stamp cards early—quantities are limited! Different coloured cards correspond to different sets of prizes, and are given out on a first come, first served basis.🖤❤️🤍

This event is made possible by Secret Signals @Secret_Signals in partnership with @mckinleyhill_, @thearchivesbooth (IG), @eaJPark_PH, @russetaccessories (IG), @tomntomsph (IG), @PAWSPhilippines, and Liberty Grounds Events.

See you there!
